what.title: The Token of Reciprocity
what.body: A Tope is not money or a fixed price—it's a measure of appreciation. Designed to spark sharing, it carries no exact market value, keeping our exchange community human, flexible, and free from conventional currency rules.

earn.title: The 4 Levels of Appreciation
earn.body:
Use the scale bar to set your level of appreciation:

Quick Hand (1–50 Topes): Small favors, tool loans, garden surpluses.

Sharing (100–500 Topes): One-hour help, specialized gear loans.

Commitment (1,000–3,000 Topes): Skill sharing, long-term vehicle loans.

Rare Resource (5,000+ Topes): Workspace access, rare expertise.

Tip: Typing an amount or tapping the gradient bar syncs your choice automatically.

spend.title: Seasonal Community Airdrops
spend.body: You don't need to hoard Topes. Complete your profile and publish resources to earn initial tokens. During community campaigns, participating active members receive seasonal token drops (3,000 to 8,000 Topes) to keep the reciprocity flowing!

what.title: What is a campaign?
what.body: A campaign is a period chosen by a member of Tope-là to focus the community's efforts on a specific need. A surplus to clear, renovating a barn, organizing a neighborhood party, ... A spotlight on a project, so everyone pitches in at the same time.

create.title: Why participate?
create.body: To quickly earn a lot of Topes. When you offer resources or declare a need in an active campaign, your rewards are multiplied by 5 or 10. You can pocket between 3,000 and 8,000 Topes at once with the airdrop. You give a boost to a concrete project and stock up on Topes for your future needs.

join.title: Joining a campaign
join.body:
Choose an ongoing campaign that interests you.
Offer at least 2 needs or resources related to the campaign.
Once your resources or needs are validated, they join the campaign and your Topes quickly arrive in your account, following the reward delay and the campaign's airdrop date.

contribute.title: Using your Topes
contribute.body:
These Topes are not meant to sit idle in your account!
Use them immediately to request help from other network members.

settle.title: Taking action
settle.body:
Do you have some free time or equipment gathering dust?
Browse active campaigns around you and offer your resources and needs.
And if you have an idea to bring to life, start your own campaign and invite the community to focus their efforts with you!
